typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		number as string,
		city as string,
		boma_type_overriden as string,
		campus as string,
		name as string,
		active as string,
		boma_type as string,
		capacity_ratio as string,
		cmn_location_source as string,
		capacity as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		number as string,
		city as string,
		boma_type_overriden as string,
		campus as string,
		name as string,
		active as string,
		boma_type as string,
		capacity_ratio as boolean,
		cmn_location_source as string,
		capacity as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		number,
		city,
		boma_type_overriden,
		campus,
		name,
		active,
		boma_type,
		capacity_ratio,
		cmn_location_source,
		capacity),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
